# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(EpiExposure)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(grid)
```
# Data importation

```{r}
data("epi_data")

head(epi_data)

sim_data = epi_data

```

# Visualizing exposure histories

```{r}
wetness_plot = epi_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(time,wetness, group = epi_id))+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#55A868",linewidth = 0.3)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Days after planting the rice",
       y = "Leaf wetness (hours)")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,85), expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = pretty(sim_data$time, n = 8))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10))

wetness_plot
```

```{r}
rain_plot = epi_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(time,rain, group = epi_id))+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#4C72B0",linewidth = 0.3)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Daily precipitation (mm)")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,85), expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = pretty(sim_data$time, n = 8))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 10))

rain_plot
```

```{r}
tmean_plot = epi_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(time,tmean, group = epi_id))+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#C44E52",linewidth = 0.3)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Mean temperature (°C)")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,85), expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = pretty(sim_data$time, n = 8))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 10))

tmean_plot
```

```{r}

plot_grid(tmean_plot,rain_plot,wetness_plot, ncol = 1)


ggsave("figure/exposure_lag.png", dpi = 600, bg = "white", height = 6, width = 8)
```

# Model fitting

```{r}

cb <- define_exposures(
  data = sim_data,
  vars = c("wetness","tmean","rain"),
  max_lag = 85,
  df_var = 3,
  df_lag = 2
)

```

```{r}
dat <- build_design(
  data = sim_data,
  cb_templates = cb,
  max_lag = 85
)

```

```{r}

dat <- prepare_response(data = dat, response = "y", family = "beta")

```

```{r}
fit <- fit_epidlnm(
  data = dat,
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  random_effect = NULL,
  epiexposure_spec = attr(cb, "spec")
)

summary(fit)
```

# Structure checking

```{r}

check_identifiability(data = sim_data,
                      var = c("tmean","rain","wetness"),
                      df_var = 3, df_lag = 2, max_lag = 85)

```

# Effect summarization

## Lag-specific

```{r}

epi_l = summarise_effects(fit = fit, data = sim_data,
                  scale = "lag", effect_measure = "percent",
                  uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 20,
                  output = "summary",
                  at = list (
                    tmean = seq(15,35, length.out = 1000),
                    rain = seq(0,15, length.out = 1000),
                    wetness = seq(0,24, length.out = 1000)))

epi_l
```

```{r}
epi_l |> 
  filter(var == "tmean") |> 
  filter(lag == 1) |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect), color = "#C44E52", se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_lower), color = "#C44E52", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_upper), color = "#C44E52", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Exposure (°C)",
       y = "Effect")
```
```{r}
epi_l |> 
  filter(var == "rain") |> 
  filter(lag == 1) |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect), color = "#4C72B0", se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_lower), color = "#4C72B0", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_upper), color = "#4C72B0", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Exposure (mm)",
       y = "Effect")
```

```{r}
epi_l |> 
  filter(var == "wetness") |> 
  filter(lag == 1) |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect), color = "#55A868", se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_lower), color = "#55A868", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_upper), color = "#55A868", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Exposure (hours)",
       y = "Effect")
```


```{r}
lag_plot <- plot_effects(
  data = epi_l,
  scale = "lag",
  var = c("tmean", "rain", "wetness"),
  metric = c("effect", "delta"),
  delta_multiplier = 100,
  ylab = c(
    tmean   = "Mean temperature (°C)",
    rain    = "Daily precipitation (mm)",
    wetness = "Leaf wetness (hours)"
  )
)

lag_plot

ggsave("figure/lag_effect.png",dpi = 600, width = 10, height = 8)

```

## Phase-specific

```{r}

period  = define_periods(max_lag = 85, cuts = c(20,40,60), prefix = "Period")

period
```

```{r}
epi_p = summarise_effects(fit = fit, data = sim_data,
                  scale = "period", effect_measure = "percent",
                  lag_periods = period,
                  uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 20,
                  output = "samples")

epi_p
```

```{r}
period_plot <- plot_effects(
  data = epi_p,
  scale = "period",
  var = c("tmean", "rain", "wetness"),
  period_order = c(
    "Period4",
    "Period3",
    "Period2",
    "Period1"
  ),
  var_order = c(
    "tmean",
    "rain",
    "wetness"
  )
)

period_plot

ggsave("figure/phase_effect.png",dpi = 600, width = 8, height = 6)

```


# Exposure Cumulative Impact (ECI)

## Overall

```{r}
ct = compute_eci(
  data = sim_data,
  group = "epi_id",
  group_level = NULL,
  fit = fit,
  var = c("tmean", "rain", "wetness"),
  scale = "link",
  uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 10,
                  output = "samples"
)

ct

```


## Lag

```{r}
ct2  = compute_ecilag(
  data = sim_data,
  group = "epi_id",
  time = "time",
  fit = fit,
  group_level = c(1,2),
  var = c("wetness","tmean","rain"),
  uncertainty = TRUE,
  n_samples = 10,
  output = "samples",
  extrapolation = "warn",
  ref = list(method = "median", value = NULL)
  )
```

```{r}
ct2$eci_summary
```

```{r}
ct2$ECI_weighted_samples
```

```{r}
ct2$by_lag_samples
```

```{r}
ct2$by_lag
```

```{r}
eci_plot <- plot_eci(
  eci_overall = ct,
  eci_lag = ct2,
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  overall_nrow = 3,
  lag_ncol = 1,
  sample_smooth = TRUE,
  linewidth = 0.7,
  alpha = 0.20,
  panel_labels = c("(a)", "(b)", "(c)"),
  overall_col = "ECI_weighted",
  lag_col = "ECI_percent")

eci_plot

```

```{r}
ggsave("figure/eci.png",dpi = 600, width = 8, height = 6)
```


```{r}

ct3 = ct2$by_lag

ct2$by_lag_samples

ct_tmean = ct3 %>% 
  filter(var == "tmean")


cor.test(ct_tmean$exposure_minus_reference,
         ct_tmean$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")

cor.test(ct_tmean$lag,
         ct_tmean$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")
```


```{r}
ct_rain = ct3 %>% 
  filter(var == "rain")


cor.test(ct_rain$exposure_minus_reference,
         ct_rain$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")

cor.test(ct_rain$lag, 
         ct_rain$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")
```

```{r}
ct_wetness = ct3 %>% 
  filter(var == "wetness")


cor.test(ct_wetness$exposure_minus_reference,
         ct_wetness$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")

cor.test(ct_wetness$lag, 
         ct_wetness$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")
```

# Simulations and outcome predictions

## Scenario 01

```{r}
exposure_tmean_01 <- simulate_exposures(max_lag = 85,
                  mode = "profile", seed = 123,
                  #pattern = "alternating_times",
                  #alternating_values = c(20,24),
                  #background = list(dist = "normal", mean = 25, sd = 10),
                  background = list(dist = "ar1", mean = 30, sd = 4, phi = 0.90),
                  n = 1)

exposure_rain_01 <- simulate_exposures(max_lag = 85,
                  mode = "pattern", seed = 123,
                  pattern = "block_times",
                  block_times = c(0,40),
                  fixed_value = 15,
                  background = list(dist = "fixed", value = 0),
                  n = 1)

exposure_wetness_01 <- simulate_exposures(max_lag = 85,
                  mode = "profile", seed = 1234,
                  #alternating_values = c(5,15),
                  background = list(dist = "ar1", mean = 20,
                  sd = 4, phi = 0.90),n = 1)

#head(exposure_tmean$profiles)
```

```{r}

df_tmean_01 <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  exposure_tmean_01$profile,
  ~ tibble(
      simulation = .y,
      time = 0:85,
      value = as.numeric(.x)
    )
)



df_tmean_01 <- data.frame(
  time = 0:85,
  value = as.numeric(exposure_tmean_01$profile)
)

df_tmean_01 <- df_tmean_01 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lag = max(time) - time
  )

plot_tmean_simu_01  = df_tmean_01%>% 
  ggplot(aes(lag,value))+
  #geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#4C72B0",linewidth = 1.4)+
  geom_line(color = "#C44E52", size = 1.4)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Lag",
       y = "Exposure")+
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 85),
  breaks = seq(0, 85, by = 10)
)+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

plot_tmean_simu_01
```

```{r}
df_rain_01 <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  exposure_rain_01$profile,
  ~ tibble(
      simulation = .y,
      time = 0:85,
      value = as.numeric(.x)
    )
)

df_rain_01 <- data.frame(
  time = 0:85,
  value = as.numeric(exposure_rain_01$profile)
)

df_rain_01 <- df_rain_01 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lag = max(time) - time
  )

plot_rain_simu_01  = df_rain_01%>% 
  ggplot(aes(lag,value))+
  #geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#4C72B0",linewidth = 1.4)+
  geom_line(color = "#4C72B0", size = 1.4)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Lag",
       y = "Exposure")+
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 85),
  breaks = seq(0, 85, by = 10))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

plot_rain_simu_01
```

```{r}
df_wetness_01 <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  exposure_wetness_01$profile,
  ~ tibble(
      simulation = .y,
      time = 0:85,
      value = as.numeric(.x)
    )
)

df_wetness_01 <- data.frame(
  time = 0:85,
  value = as.numeric(exposure_wetness_01$profile)
)

df_wetness_01 <- df_wetness_01 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lag = max(time) - time
  )

plot_wetness_simu_01  = df_wetness_01%>% 
  ggplot(aes(lag,value))+
  #geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#4C72B0",linewidth = 1.4)+
  geom_line(color = "#55A868", size = 1.4)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Lag",
       y = "Exposure")+
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 85),
  breaks = seq(0, 85, by = 10))+

plot_wetness_simu_01
```

```{r}
pred_01 <- predict_outcomes(
  fit = fit,
  profiles = list(
    tmean = exposure_tmean_01$profile,
    rain = exposure_rain_01$profile,
    wetness = exposure_wetness_01$profile
  ),
  uncertainty = TRUE,
  n_samples = 100,
  output = "samples"
)

pred_01
```

```{r}

pred_011 = pred_01 |> 
  summarise(
    mean = mean(prediction),
    median = median(prediction)
  )

sev_01  = pred_01 |> 
  ggplot(aes(prediction))+
  geom_histogram(color = "white", fill = "black", bins = 10)+
    geom_vline(data = pred_011, aes(xintercept = mean), color = "orange",size =1)+
  geom_vline(data = pred_011, aes(xintercept = median), color = "red",size =1)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Predicted",
       y = "Frequency")+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

sev_01
```

```{r}
median(pred_01$prediction)
mean(pred_01$prediction)
```

# Scenarios simulation

## Varying

```{r}
range <- simulate_ranges(
  periods = period,
  vary = list(
    #tmean = seq(18,34, by = 1),
    tmean = c(20,34),
    #rain = c(0,15),
    rain = seq(0,15, by = 1),
    wetness = c(2,10)
  ),
  scenario_type = "grid",
  scenario_var = "rain"
)

```

```{r}
pred_scenarios = simulate_scenarios(
  fit = fit,
  scenarios = range,
  data = sim_data,
  uncertainty = TRUE,
  output = "samples",
  n_samples = 20,
  seed = 123)

pred_scenarios
```

```{r}
plot_scenarios(
  data = pred_scenarios,
  x = "rain",
  facet = c("wetness", "tmean"),
  #scale_factor = 100,
  x_limits = c(0, 15),
  output = "samples"
)


ggsave("figure/simulate_scenarios2.png", dpi = 600, height = 6, width = 8)
```

## Fixed

```{r}
range2 <- simulate_ranges(
  periods = period,
  vary = list(rain = c(1,3,5,15,20)),
  fixed = list(
    tmean = 34,
    wetness = 10
  ),
  scenario_type = "paired"
)

```


```{r}
pred_scenarios2 = simulate_scenarios(
  fit = fit,
  scenarios = range2,
  data = sim_data,
  uncertainty = TRUE,
  output = "samples",
  n_samples = 20,
  seed = 1234)

pred_scenarios2

```

```{r}
plot_scenarios(
  data = pred_scenarios2,
  x = "rain",
  scenario_type = "paired",
  #scale_factor = 100,
  pointrange_color = "black",
  point_size = 0.5,
  pointrange_linewidth = 0.8
)
```

# Comparative analysis

## Exposures

```{r}

compare_exp_tmean = compare_exposures(
  exposure1 = exposure_tmean_01$profile,
  exposure2 = exposure_tmean_02$profile,
  mode = "timewise"
)

exp_tmean = compare_exp_tmean |> 
  ggplot(aes(time,diff))+
  geom_line(size = 1.4, color = "#C44E52")+
  labs(x = "Time",
       y = "Difference")+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))+
  theme_bw()

exp_tmean
```

```{r}

compare_exp_tmean = compare_exposures(
  exposure1 = exposure_tmean_01$profile,
  exposure2 = exposure_tmean_02$profile,
  mode = "timewise"
)

exp_tmean_ratio = compare_exp_tmean |> 
  ggplot(aes(time,ratio))+
  geom_line(size = 1.4, color = "#C44E52")+
  labs(x = "Time",

  theme(text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))+
  theme_bw()

```

# Prediction

## Best fit

```{r}
library(future)

future::plan(
  future::multisession,
  workers = 25
)

future::nbrOfWorkers()
```

```{r}


best_models <- find_bestfit(
  data = sim_data,
  response = "y",
  group = "epi_id",
  time = "time",
  vars = c(
    "tmean",
    "rain",
    "wetness"
  ),
  max_lag = 85,
  df_var_grid = 4,
  df_lag_grid = 4,
  min_vars = 1,
  var_sets = list(
    c("tmean", "rain","wetness")
  ),
  fun_var = "ns",
  fun_lag = "ns",
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  random_effect = NULL,
  min_success = 2,
  verbose = TRUE,
  keep_fits = TRUE,
  cv_method = "k-fold", k = 5
)

attr(best_models, "predictions_by_model")

```

```{r}
ws <- attr(best_models, "warning_summary")

ws[
  ws$model_id == 63,
  c(
    "model_id",
    "df_var",
    "df_lag",
    "vars",
    "n_warning_folds",
    "warning_rate",
    "n_warning_events",
    "n_warning_types",
    "warning_messages",
    "full_refit_warning_events",
    "full_refit_warning_messages"
  )
]

ccc_lab <- best_m |>
  filter(model_id %in% c(63,42,56,35,49,28,40,61,19,47,33,54,
                         26,12,5)) |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("CCC = %.2f", CCC))

best_pred |>
  filter(model_id %in% c(63,42,56,35,49,28,40,61,19,47,33,54,
                         26,12,5)) |>
  ggplot(aes(observed*100, predicted*100)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "orange") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red",
              linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_text(
    data = ccc_lab,
    aes(label = label),
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5) +

  facet_wrap(~model_id, ncol = 5) +

  labs(
    x = "Observed (%)",
    y = "Predicted (%)"

  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

plot_performance(
  object = best_models,
  model_id = c(
    63, 42, 56, 35, 49, 28, 40, 61,
    19, 47, 33, 54, 26, 12, 5
  ),
  metrics = c("CCC", "Cb", "rho"),
  x = "observed",
  y = "predicted",
  scale_factor = 100,
  ncol = 5,
  x_lab = "Observed (%)",
  y_lab = "Predicted (%)",
  size = 2.5
) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
```

## Ensemble

```{r}
ens_mean <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best_models,
  ensemble_scope = "model",
  method = "unweighted",
  model_id = c(63, 23, 44),
  weight_metric = "CCC",
  hb = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

ens_weighted <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best_models,
  ensemble_scope = "model",
  method = "weighted",
  model_id = c(63, 23, 44),
  weight_metric = "CCC",
  weight_transform = "rank_inverse",
  hb = TRUE
)

ens_stack <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best_models,
  ensemble_scope = "model",
  method = "stacked",
  model_id = c(63, 23, 44),
  stacking_model = "ridge",
  stack_objective = "regularized",
  lambda = 1e-6,
  stack_intercept = TRUE
)

CCC_ensemble = rbind(
  unweighted = ens_mean$ensemble_summary[, c(
    "CCC", "Cb", "rho", "RMSE", "MAE"
  )],
 
  weighted = ens_weighted$ensemble_summary[, c(
    "CCC", "Cb", "rho", "RMSE", "MAE"
  )],
 
  stacked = ens_stack$ensemble_summary[, c(
    "CCC", "Cb", "rho", "RMSE", "MAE"
  )]
)

CCC_ensemble$method = c("unweighted","weighted","stacked")
```

```{r}

ens_mean$ensemble_predictions$method = "unweighted"
ens_weighted$ensemble_predictions$method = "weighted"
ens_stack$ensemble_predictions$method = "stacked"

ensemble_all = rbind(ens_mean$ensemble_predictions,ens_weighted$ensemble_predictions, ens_stack$ensemble_predictions)


```

```{r}

ordem_methods <- c(
  "unweighted",
  "weighted",
  "stacked"
)

ensemble_plot <- ensemble_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(method)) %>%
  mutate(
    method = as.character(method)
  ) %>%
  filter(method %in% ordem_methods) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = ordem_methods
    )
  )



CCC_plot <- CCC_ensemble %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = ordem_methods
    )
  )



pos_CCC <- ensemble_plot %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    x = min(observed, na.rm = TRUE) +
      0.05 * diff(range(observed, na.rm = TRUE)),
   
    y = max(predicted_ensemble, na.rm = TRUE) -
      0.05 * diff(range(predicted_ensemble, na.rm = TRUE)),
   
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    CCC_plot %>% select(method, CCC),
    by = "method"
  )



 ensemble_gg = ggplot(ensemble_plot,aes(observed*100, predicted_ensemble*100)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",se = FALSE, color = "orange") +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = pos_CCC,
    aes(
      x = 2,
      y = 97,
      label = sprintf("CCC = %.2f", CCC)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~method,
    ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
    scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)
  ) +
 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Observed (%)",
    y = "Predicted (%)") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10,face = "bold"),legend.position = "none")


 ggsave("figure/ensemble.png", dpi = 600, bg = "white", height = 6, width = 10)
```

# Sensitivity

```{r}
range_rain = simulate_ranges(
     periods = period,
     vary = list(
       tmean = 25,
       rain  = seq(0,15, by = 0.5),
       wetness = 10
     ),
     scenario_type = "grid",
     scenario_var = "rain"
)

range_tmean = simulate_ranges(
     periods = period,
     vary = list(
       rain = 5,
       tmean  = seq(18,34, by = 0.5),
       wetness = 2
     ),
     scenario_type = "grid",
     scenario_var = "tmean"
)


range_wetness = simulate_ranges(
     periods = period,
     vary = list(
       rain = 5,
       wetness  = seq(0,24, by = 0.5),
       tmean = 25
     ),
     scenario_type = "grid",
     scenario_var = "wetness"
)

pred_rain = simulate_scenarios(
  fit = fit,
  data = sim_data,
  scenarios = range_tmean,
  uncertainty = TRUE,
  output = "samples",
  n_samples = 20
)

curve_rain = pred_rain |> 
    group_by(sample) |> 
  transmute(
    value = tmean,
    prediction = prediction*100
   # lower = prediction_lower*100,
    #upper = prediction_upper*100
  ) |>
  arrange(value)



curve_rain = as.data.frame(curve_rain)


sens_rain = epi_sensitivity(
  data = curve_rain,
  x = "value",
  y = "prediction",
  scenario_var = "sample",
  elasticity = TRUE,
  critical = TRUE,
  method = "finite",
  k = 3)

sens_rain |> 
  ggplot(aes(value, sensitivity, group = sample))+
  #geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "black")+
  theme_bw()

cor.test(sens_rain$value,
         sens_rain$elasticity,
         method = "kendall")

sens_rain |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(value, prediction),se = F, color = "black")+
  geom_smooth(aes(value, lower),se = F,
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_smooth(aes(value, upper),se = F,
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed")+
  theme_bw()


sens_rain |> 
  ggplot(aes(value,sensitivity))+
  geom_smooth(se = F)

```

# Lag-specific animation

## tmean
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(dplyr)

epi_plot <- epi_l |>
  filter(var == "tmean")

tmean_ani = ggplot(
  epi_plot,
  aes(value, effect)
) +
  geom_line(
    color = "#C44E52",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Mean temperature (°C)",
    y = "Effect (%)",
    title = "Lag: {closest_state}"
  ) +
  transition_states(
    lag,
    transition_length = 1,
    state_length = 1
  ) +
  ease_aes("linear")
```

## rain
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(dplyr)

epi_plot <- epi_l |>
  filter(var == "rain")

rain_ani = ggplot(
  epi_plot,
  aes(value, effect)
) +
  geom_line(
    color = "#4c72b0",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Mean temperature (°C)",
    y = "Effect (%)",
    title = "Lag: {closest_state}"
  ) +
  transition_states(

    transition_length = 1,
    state_length = 1
  ) +
  ease_aes("linear")
```

## wetness
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(dplyr)

epi_plot <- epi_l |>
  filter(var == "wetness")

wetness_ani = ggplot(
  epi_plot,
  aes(value, effect)
) +
  geom_line(
    color = "#55A868",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Leaf wetness (hours)",
    y = "Effect (%)",
    title = "Lag: {closest_state}"
  ) +
  transition_states(
    lag,
    transition_length = 1,
    state_length = 1
  ) +
  ease_aes("linear")

anim1 <- animate(tmean_ani, nframes = 85, renderer = magick_renderer())
anim2 <- animate(rain_ani, nframes = 85, renderer = magick_renderer())
anim3 <- animate(wetness_ani, nframes = 85, renderer = magick_renderer())

```

```{r}

combined_frames <- image_append(c(anim1[1], anim2[1],anim3[1]))
for (i in 3:length(anim1)) {
  combined <- image_append(c(anim1[i], anim2[i],anim3[i]))
  combined_frames <- c(combined_frames, combined)
}

anim_save("combined.gif", combined_frames)
```
